prompt: I have a small design doc at `implementation-planner/evals/test-design-healthcheck.md` for a Go health check library. Generate implementation tasks in `/tmp/healthcheck-tasks/`.

assertions.text: Produces 2-4 tasks (not over-split for this small scope)
Output contains numbered markdown files (NNN-name.md pattern)
Each task file has a Test Plan section
Each task file has Acceptance Criteria
At least one task addresses concurrent check execution and thread safety
No task has only a single trivial acceptance criterion
